market.question: Will STRC hit $100 by December 31?
market.exact_rule: Yes if any TradingView 1 minute candle for STRC between market creation and the listed date, 11:59 PM ET, has a final “High” value of at least $100. Otherwise No. Resolution source is TradingView STRC “High” values with chart settings on 1m. If price data is unavailable from TradingView for any relevant period at the listed date 11:59 PM ET, use WSJ Markets, Google Finance, then MarketWatch in that order. If none has relevant data, resolve based on available data then.

tradingview_page_capture.limitations: Captured public page is browser application shell, not candle payload. Static source names a WebSocket host; repository script scan found no existing TradingView anonymous history transport. No JS execution, WebSocket client, endpoint guessing or auth bypass attempted. Existing response does not establish a 1-minute interval configuration or any candle UTC time/High.

bounded_result: No qualifying observed 1-minute High candle identified in this pass; this is a source-data gap, not evidence that threshold was or was not reached. No fallback source fetched because this pass checked TradingView path only and the frozen fallback clause applies if TradingView data is unavailable at resolution time.
limits: No price values, order book, probability, or position inspected.
No claim that TradingView data is unavailable for all relevant periods.
